element.name: Fang of the Dragon of Statues (Slumbering)

description.p: Forged from the mighty scale of Iymrith, the ancient blue Dragon of Statues reigning over the desolate expanse of the desert Anauroch, this dagger holds unparalleled power.

Its core, a formidable eight-inch blade, bears a razor-sharp edge reminiscent of the dragon's own claws, its steel infused with an electric cobalt hue resonating with the dragon's presence. At its hilt, a meticulously crafted blue dragon's head emerges, an awe-inspiring symbol of the weapon's origins and the dominance of Iymrith.
The Fang was once the arcane focus of Amtar Rajul. Since his death it has passed to his brother, Umtar, and the slumbering dragon within has begun to answer to a new bearer.

Element. The Fang channels one element: acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder (Iymrith's own element is lightning). Choose it when you attune to the dagger. "Your element" below refers to that choice.
Dragon's Revenge. Once per turn, when you are hit by an attack made by a creature within 10 feet of you, the attacker takes 1d6 damage of your element. This requires no reaction.

p.em: In Borealis the Fang's attunement and properties live on the separate item "Fang of the Dragon of Statues: Bond (Slumbering)". Equip and attune the Bond (it is worn, so your hands stay free), and equip this dagger only when you wield it. Don't attune the dagger itself.

element.name: Fang of the Dragon of Statues: Bond (Slumbering)

description.p: The bond between the Fang of the Dragon of Statues and its bearer. Equip it (worn) and attune to it while you have the Fang on your person, whether the dagger is in your hand or not. It holds the Fang's attunement and properties; the dagger item is only the weapon you attack with.

description.p: Iymrith's fury is fully awake. Storm light pours from the blade, and those who meet the eyes of the dragon's head feel the ancient wyrm looking back at them.

Draconic Might. While you are attuned to the Fang and carry it on your person, you gain a +2 bonus to the attack rolls and damage rolls of all your weapon attacks and spell attacks, including attacks with other weapons.

Ominous Presence (1/Long Rest). As a bonus action, you unleash the dragon's dread. Each creature of your choice within 60 feet of you that can see you must make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, a creature is frightened of you. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. You can't use this property again until you finish a long rest.

description.p: You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this weapon.
A creature attuned to the sword gains the following property while the sword is on its person.

Preserve Fate. The sword has a large gem on the hilt that can store a moment of fate for later use. Whenever you make an ability check, or an attack roll or saving throw against an evil creature, you can preserve that roll in the sword and roll again. The preserved fate recolors the gem: red for an attack roll, green for a saving throw, blue for an ability check. The preserved roll stays in the sword until you use a free action to replace a roll you just made with it, provided the roll is of the type that matches the gem's color.
The sword can hold only one preserved fate at a time.
The hilt, which is sentient, knows that it can never be reunited with its original crystal blade. It has, however, gained the properties of a sun blade.

sheet.description: Preserve Fate. When you make an ability check, or an attack roll or saving throw against an evil creature, you can store the roll in the gem and reroll. Later, as a free action, replace a roll of the matching type (red attack, green save, blue check) with the stored one. One stored fate at a time.

description.p: Forged from scaled iron said to be quenched in the embers of Klauth, this glaive hums with a slow, volcanic pulse. Charred leather binds the haft; the black-red blade glitters like cooled magma.
Draconic Resolve. While attuned, you have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.
Deflective Scales (1/Short Rest). When you are hit by an attack, you can reduce the damage by an amount equal to your proficiency bonus.

sheet.description: Advantage on saves against being frightened. Deflective Scales: when hit by an attack, reduce the damage by {{proficiency}}.

description.p: The glaive's glow brightens, sparks of draconic power licking along the edge.
Stirring. You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this weapon.
Draconic Resolve. You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.
Deflective Scales (1/Short Rest). When you are hit by an attack, you can reduce the damage by an amount equal to your proficiency bonus.
Draconic Surge. On a critical hit, the glaive erupts with draconic energy, dealing an extra 1d10 damage of the weapon's type.
Dragon's Guidance (1/Long Rest). After you roll but before the result is known, add a d4 to an attack roll, saving throw, or ability check.

sheet.description: Advantage on saves against being frightened. Deflective Scales (1/short rest): when hit, reduce the damage by {{proficiency}}. Crits deal +1d10 weapon damage. Dragon's Guidance (1/long rest): add a d4 to an attack roll, save or check.

description.p: A roaring heat fills the blade; dragon spirits whirl within its edge.
Wakened. You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this weapon.
Critical Strike. Your attack rolls with this weapon score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

Scaled Martyr (Reaction, 1/Long Rest). When a creature you can see within 50 feet of you is hit by an attack, you can plunge the glaive into the ground and call draconic spirits to divert the blow. The creature takes no damage and instead regains hit points equal to the prevented damage, and you take force damage equal to the damage it would have taken. This fails if the original attack would have instantly killed the creature.
Draconic Resolve. You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.
Deflective Scales (1/Short Rest). When you are hit by an attack, you can reduce the damage by an amount equal to your proficiency bonus.
Draconic Surge. On a critical hit, the glaive deals an extra 1d10 damage of its type.
Dragon's Guidance (1/Long Rest). After you roll but before the result is known, add a d4 to one attack roll, saving throw, or ability check.

sheet.description: Crit on 19-20; crits deal +1d10 weapon damage. Scaled Martyr (reaction, 1/long rest): an ally within 50 ft. that is hit takes no damage and heals that much; you take it as force damage. Advantage on saves against being frightened. Deflective Scales (1/short rest): reduce damage by {{proficiency}}. Dragon's Guidance (1/long rest): add a d4.
